text:
Lina (Marketing): @here quick sync: planning a 3-week micro-tutorial + benchmark play to drive OSS refapp adoption and capture inbound leads. high-level: 5 microtutorials (15–20m each), a live/recorded bench webcast week 2, and a lightweight leaderboard + lead-form tagging. thoughts? :rocket:
Ravi (DevRel): love it. can own tutorial flow and short code snippets. propose 'start -> integrate -> optimize' arc per tutorial so it scales.
Sofia (Product): keep the messaging focused on "predictable inference" and cost/latency examples. need one customer POV or internal case to anchor the webcast narrative.
Alex (Eng): for benching we should provide a one-command harness and docker image. minimal infra: single-GPU micro-bench script + synthetic dataset. we can expose a results JSON so leaderboard auto-updates.
Marta (Docs): i'll draft 5 quickstarts and a consolidated README. can we standardize a repo layout? suggest /tutorials/{01-05} and /bench. i'll PR a template today.
Sam (Growth): inbound routing: capture form fields for 'interest' (tutorials, bench, enterprise), map to HubSpot list + UTM. add hidden field for "model-type" so we can segment by customers chasing cost vs latency. also want CTAs at end of each tutorial to an interactive sandbox.
Ravi (DevRel): for code snippets i'll use short runnable examples. sample start command: ```bash
# run local refapp (dev)
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-sample.git
cd refapp-sample
docker build -t refapp:local .
docker run -e REDWOOD_KEY=$REDWOOD_KEY -p 8080:8080 refapp:local
# then
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Alex (Eng): +1. also include quick quantization tips and a script: `python bench/run_bench.py --model redwood-13b --seq 512 --iters 50`. will add to repo.
Marta (Docs): linking repo draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-sample/tree/marketing-microtutorial (WIP)
Sam (Growth): for the webinar we should have 2 CTAs: 1) play with the sandbox 2) request a dedicated trial. I'll wire the funnel and a short thank-you flow with a follow-up email sequence.
Sofia (Product): can Product provide 2 slides: architecture + cost/latency graph. Alex can supply numbers from initial runs. deadline: EOD Thu?
Alex (Eng): can do baseline numbers by tomorrow noon. will attach a short CSV and a sample plot.
Ravi (DevRel): timeline proposal: week 0: repo + quickstarts; week 1: tutorial drip (2 tutorials); week 2: webcast + bench release + leaderboard; week 3: remaining tutorials + follow-ups.
Lina (Marketing): love that timeline. final asks: 1) Marta — publish tutorial template by EOD today; 2) Alex — baseline bench CSV by tomorrow noon; 3) Sam — hubspot mapping doc by Friday; 4) Ravi — first two tutorial drafts by next Tue. i'll draft the external launch post + tweet thread once we have the first tutorial and bench numbers. :zap:
Marta (Docs): on it. will open PR and tag reviewers.
inbound-bot: form-submission received: user "olivia@example.com" for "bench" interest (auto-tagged). forwarding to growth queue.
Sam (Growth): nice — live test working. i'll confirm the hubspot mapping and show expected contact lists.
Lina (Marketing): next sync Thu 10am PT. please add blockers here before then. i'll create the editorial calendar and shared Notion doc. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
